svg.title: Voltage divider · live circuit values
svg.desc: Solving for VMID. Yellow means undefined or invalid input; green means defined; red identifies the solve target. VTOP: Defined. VMID: Solving for. RTOP: Defined. RBOT: Defined. RL: Defined. Nominal VMID 6 V; minimum 5.94 V; maximum 6.06 V. VTOP 12 V · ±0%. VMID 6 V. Each symbol is a physical resistor; RTOP and RBOT labels show equivalent arm values. R1 M55342E11B14E3RTS: 14.3 kΩ, ±1%, 50 mW rated at 70 °C; 50 mW allowed at 70 °C in rated mode; Pstress 5.03%, Vstress 22.44%, Istress 22.44%. Alternative TNPW040214K3FEED: 70 mW allowed at 70 °C, 75 V, general. R2 M55342E11B14E3RTS: 14.3 kΩ, ±1%, 50 mW rated at 70 °C; 50 mW allowed at 70 °C in rated mode; Pstress 5.03%, Vstress 22.44%, Istress 22.44%. Alternative TNPW040214K3FEED: 70 mW allowed at 70 °C, 75 V, general. Footprints: R1 0402, R2 0402. Selected-part stresses use nominal circuit values.
